rows.quantity_definition: raw cotton left for manufacture annual mean
rows.notes: not adjusted for raw stock change or non-spinning use

rows.quantity_definition: direct cotton yarn export expressed as raw-cotton equivalent
rows.notes: not actual yarn weight; implied actual weight requires reversing the reported uplift

rows.quantity_definition: cotton cloth retained for home consumption annual mean
rows.notes: route of underlying home-consumption estimate not stated

rows.quantity_definition: raw-equivalent uplift applied to exported yarn
rows.notes: assumption rather than measured national process loss
practical approximation across all cloth kinds
practical approximation across all cloth kinds

rows.quantity_definition: raw cotton embodied in exported cloth
rows.calculation: export cloth yards divided by six

rows.quantity_definition: raw cotton embodied in home-consumed cloth
rows.calculation: home cloth yards divided by five

rows.quantity_definition: raw cotton embodied in exported and home-consumed cloth
rows.calculation: export plus home cloth raw equivalents
rows.notes: downstream cloth disposition not direct yarn delivery

rows.quantity_definition: unassigned retained raw under reported yarn raw-equivalent branch
rows.calculation: retained raw minus reported yarn raw equivalent minus cloth raw equivalent
rows.notes: 0.5992 percent of retained availability but stock change remains absent
